text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Syrian President Assad told Prime Minister Hariri during a four hour meeting in Damascus that Syria supports any French and European role in the Middle East peace process.
-Minister of Environment Shhayyeb said the containers of toxic and plastic waste at Beirut port will be taken away by the end of February.
-The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose in mid February to $6,171.1 million at the end of January, the central bank reported.
-President Hrawi will visit Damascus within 72 hours to meet President Assad.
-The weekly treasury bill issue of February 13 raised 358.6 billion Lebanese pounds.
-The five-nation committee monitoring ceasefire agreement in south Lebanon met until midnight to discuss Lebanese and Israeli complaints.
-Lebanon's revenues from property taxes reached $10.979 million at end of January.
-Maronite Patriarch Sfeir will head to Vatican on Wednesday.
